name: Titan
tagline: The only moon with a thick atmosphere — methane rivers, lakes and rain on a frozen water-ice world.
history: Titan is the only moon with a dense atmosphere — nitrogen laced with methane that rains into rivers and pools in hydrocarbon seas larger than Earth's Great Lakes. In 2005 the Huygens probe descended through the orange haze and landed on icy pebbles beside a flood-scoured channel: the only landing ever made in the outer Solar System. Beneath the ice crust lies a subsurface water ocean. NASA's Dragonfly rotorcraft launches in 2028 to fly between Titan's dune fields sampling prebiotic chemistry.
